chunks: That He may forgive some of your sins and prolong your term till an appointed time. Surely when God's appointed time is come it will not be put off, if only you knew!
ai.seo_question: Why does God delay punishment for disbelievers according to Surah Noah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine attribute of patience (hilm), where the delay in punishment serves as a period for repentance rather than mere postponement. The 'appointed term' (ajal musamma) signifies a fixed, inevitable deadline decreed by God, contrasting with the temporary respite granted to the disbelievers. This underscores the certainty of the Hereafter, reminding believers that while God delays to allow for forgiveness, His decree is absolute and will not be deferred once the time comes.
